description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the Suzuki OEM door glass mounting bar and rubber seals for the LH or RH Side.
This bar mounts directly to the window regulator.
If you need to do the glass in both doors then order Qty 2.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Mounting Bar
Qty 2 – Rubber Glass Seals
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
